transfer_provisions.quote: The Secretary of the Treasury is hereby designated to perform the functions of the President under the following provisions of law: (1) sections 603(b), 604(a), and 611 of the ATDA Act ... and (2) sections 703, 704(a), 805(b), 806(a), 807(a), 808(a), and 812 of the Foreign Assistance Act
transfer_provisions.note: Re-designates to Treasury the presidential functions that EO 12757 (sec. 1) delegated and that EO 12823 and EO 13131 enlarged. EO 13131's additions (805(b), 806(a), 807(a), 808(a), 812) appear here by number. EO 13345 names no Public Law 104-107 function, which EO 13028 had added.

transfer_provisions.quote: The Secretary of State is hereby designated to perform the functions of the President under sections 607 and 614 of the ATDA Act ... and section 813(a) of the Foreign Assistance Act
transfer_provisions.note: Re-designates the State functions (EO 12757 sec. 3; EO 13131's section 813 addition) and the advice-receiving function (sec. 2(d): ATDA 610(c)(1), FAA 813(b)).

transfer_provisions.quote: the following officers or employees of the United States are hereby designated to serve as representatives on the Enterprise for the Americas Board
transfer_provisions.note: Re-makes the Board membership that EO 12757 sec. 4 (as amended by EO 12823 and EO 13131 sec. 1(f)) set, including the Forest Service International Programs and CEQ designees.

transfer_provisions.quote: may further assign functions assigned by this order to officers of any department or agency within the executive branch to the extent permitted by law
transfer_provisions.note: Concerns functions assigned by EO 13345 itself; it saves nothing from the revoked orders.

effective_date_reading: Sec. 6 and the rest of the order contain no effective-date, delayed-effect or phase-in wording. It was signed July 8, 2004, filed July 12 and printed 69 FR 41901-41903 on July 13, 2004. The project takes an order with no effective wording to be effective on signing, so the revocations in sec. 6 are dated 2004-07-08.

targets_in_batch_07.EO:13028: sec. 6(c) ('Executive Order 13028 of December 3, 1996'), 69 FR 41903; not excepted
targets_in_batch_07.EO:13131: sec. 6(d) ('Executive Order 13131 of July 22, 1999'), 69 FR 41903; not excepted

conclusion: EO 13345 (signed 2004-07-08, 69 FR 41901-41903, read once in full from the held FR text) assigns Enterprise for the Americas Initiative and Tropical Forest Conservation Act functions: Treasury (sec. 1), State (sec. 2), a USAID recommendation (sec. 3), the Board (sec. 4), guidance for performing functions (sec. 5), a revocation of four orders (sec. 6: EO 12757, 12823, 13028 and 13131, each named with its date, no qualifier) and a judicial-review clause (sec. 7). It has no savings, pending-matter, transition or exception clause. Secs. 1, 2 and 4 are successor provisions: they re-designate, by statute section number, the presidential functions that EO 12757 and its three amendments had delegated (including everything EO 13131 added) and re-make the Board membership. They do not re-designate the Public Law 104-107 section 571 functions that EO 13028 added to EO 12757. The parent EO 12757 and all three amending orders are revoked in the same sentence, so the amended text ends the same day.
